tagline: The media server for anime and manga
description:
Seanime is a self-hosted media server packed with features to seamlessly stream, track, and manage your anime and manga.

Seanime does not provide, host, or distribute any media content. You are responsible for obtaining media content through legal means. The software is a tool for organizing and consuming content you already own or have legal access to. By using Seanime, you agree to comply with your local laws and regulations.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
NVIDIA NVENC/NVDEC: this variant needs an NVIDIA GPU, the NVIDIA
driver and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the Zima box, with the
`nvidia` Docker runtime available. If that runtime is missing, the
container will fail to start. The image's maintainer notes
hardware features could not be tested in CI, so check them on
your own hardware.

Different default UID: the CUDA image runs as UID:GID 1001:1001,
not 1000. The config, anime and downloads folders must be
readable and writable by that user.

This app has its own config folder and WebUI port (3214), so it
does not share settings with the other Seanime variants. Do not run
two variants against the same downloads folder at the same time.

Publishing outside your LAN: set a server password first. Seanime's
docs require server.password when the server is reachable from
outside this machine. Set SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD during install,
or edit config.toml in the config folder after the first start and
set password under [server], then restart. A password is not
encryption: prefer a VPN such as Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse
proxy over forwarding plain HTTP port 3214 on your router.

title: Seanime CUDA
release_note: Add the NVIDIA CUDA Seanime variant, pinned to v3.10.4, on host port 3214 with the nvidia runtime and optional SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD.
